statements.text: A mental event is one to whose occurrence the substance involved has privileged access: whatever ways others have of finding out about it, the subject has a further way, by experiencing it. A pure mental event is one whose occurrence does not entail the occurrence of any physical event, such as a belief that a desk is in front of one or a trying to move it.
